result.post_caption:
A quick update, because you trust my recommendations.

I linked the AirClub Convertible Bassinet in some of my posts. CPSC has since announced a recall: the way it attaches to an adult bed can leave a gap between the bassinet and the mattress, which CPSC says is a fall hazard for babies.

If you have one, don't use it, and contact AirClub for the replacement attachment. I'm removing my link from those posts.

Official notice: https://cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/AirClub-Convertible-Bassinets-Recalled-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Fall-Hazard-Violates-Mandatory-Standard-for-Bedside-Sleepers
story_script: Important update about a bassinet I shared.
It's been recalled for a fall hazard. If you own it, stop using it and contact AirClub.
I'm taking my link down. The official details are in my bio.
result.comment_reply: Thank you for asking. If you have this bassinet, please stop using it and check the recall notice in my bio. I'm removing my link.
